ops.entry: WHEN a plan-time reader's repairs each surface one narrower failure in one mechanism DO have pm key the class on what the change itself guarantees, and commission a census of the affected state before signature — a class keyed on where effects surface is still an enumeration.
ops.why: O-09 as written was applied here and did not terminate: SC-02 was restated as a class three times (by rewritten field, by printed locator, by first site), each still keyed on where effects surface, and each re-read found one more member; it terminated only when re-anchored on what the move proves, with a per-file census as evidence.

originals.original: WHEN a plan-time reader's repairs each surface one narrower failure in the same mechanism DO ask pm to state that family as a class contract with an exhaustive state enumeration before signature — instance repairs reach validate as instances, and each round there surfaces one more member.
